title: Trace-correlated percentile explorer for endpoint/model/region
creator: Aisha Rao
description:
Goal: Add a trace-correlated percentile explorer that surfaces p95/p99 and tokens/sec distributions per route / model / region and links individual percentile shifts to representative traces and request payloads. This ticket implements instrumentation, storage rollups, an interactive dashboard, and automatic regression detection (signal + statistical test).

Motivation:
- SREs and platform owners need quick root-cause for percentile regressions: is the p99 jump caused by a specific model variant, a region, or a request shape?
- Current dashboards show aggregate quantiles but lack trace correlation and tokens/sec context which slows down RCA.

Scope:
1) Instrumentation changes: sampling policy to retain trace_id for the top-k slowest requests per minute per route/model/region and attach tokens_generated and client routing metadata.
2) Telemetry pipeline: emit per-request quantile buckets (adaptive histogram) plus a light-weight summary for every 1s window; store raw sampled traces to a short-lived trace store (14 days) and rolled-up quantile series to metric-store (90 days).
3) Regression detection: implement a nightly job that computes distribution drift using Wasserstein distance + bootstrapped CI and flags statistically significant p95/p99 shifts.
4) Dashboard & UX: heatmap overview (routes vs models with region facets), ECDF overlay, top contributing trace links, tokens/sec overlay, and drilldown to replayable example requests.
5) Alerting & Runbook: severity tiers (info/warn/critical), automatic enriched alerts with example trace links and suggested mitigations (rollback to model X, reduce batch size, pin quantization profile).

Trade-offs and decisions so far:
- Sampling: full tracing for all requests is too expensive. We will do adaptive tail sampling (top-k per 1m per (route,model,region)) plus uniform 0.1% sample for long-term representative baseline. This balances cost vs signal.
- Regression test: KS-test is sensitive to ties; we chose Wasserstein distance with bootstrap-derived p-values to quantify magnitude and uncertainty, which is more interpretable for operators.
- Storage: raw sampled traces kept for 14 days to limit cost; aggregated histograms retained 90 days for longitudinal analysis.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement automated model rollbacks. That will be a separate rollout automation epic.

Acceptance criteria:
- Telemetry emitted from runtime with fields: route, model, region, tokens_generated, duration_ms, trace_id (when sampled).
- Nightly drift job produces a per-(route,model,region) table with p95/p99 baseline, current, wasserstein, and p-value.
- Dashboard renders heatmap and allows filtering by route/model/region and time window and shows 3 example traces for any selected cell.
- Alerts created for critical regressions (p99 increase > 2x and p-value < 0.01) and post-alert runbook links are included.

Implementation notes and links:
- Design spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Trace-Correlated+Percentile+Explorer
- Dashboard mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleMockups
- Prototype PR (instrumentation): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1248
- Regression job prototype (not production): https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/382

Operational costs estimate:
- Additional metric storage ~ +12% for 90d histograms.
- Trace store incremental cost depends on sampling; expected +8% at proposed sampling rates.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: land runtime instrumentation behind a feature flag, smoke test on staging.
- Week 2: pipeline ingestion + sample-end-to-end dashboard with synthetic load for two pilot routes.
- Week 3: enable in prod for low-traffic routes, monitor costs and false positives.
- Week 4: expand to 50% of routes and tune sampling thresholds.

Notes for reviewers:
- Pay attention to the schema for adaptive histograms: we chose t-digest for p95/p99 fidelity but included a compact ECDF for exact ECDF overlays in the UI.
- Verify the privacy check for attached request payloads; any PII must be redacted before trace materialization.
